info.title: PDF Blocks Universal API
info.description: Process PDFs by merging, protecting, watermarking, and editing pages

put.description: Updates a PDF document with an image watermark in PDF Blocks.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

image.description: The image to add as a watermark.

transparency.description: The transparency level for the image watermark.

margin.description: The distance in inches from the border of the page to the image watermark.

put.description: Updates a PDF document with restrictions in PDF Blocks.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

ownerPassword.description: The password required to open and change permissions of the PDF document.

userPassword.description: The password required to open the PDF document.

encryptionAlgorithm.description: The algorithm used to encrypt the PDF document.

allowCopyContent.description: If false, the user cannot copy text and images to the clipboard.

allowChangeContent.description: If false, the user cannot change the content of the document.

allowPrint.description: If false, the user cannot print the document.

allowPrintHighResolution.description: If false, the user cannot print the document in high resolution.

allowCommentAndFillForm.description: If false, the user cannot add, edit, or modify annotations or fill form fields.

allowFillForm.description: If false, the user cannot fill form fields.

allowAssembleDocument.description: If false, the user cannot assemble or manipulate the document.

allowAccessibility.description: If false, accessibility programs cannot read the text or images of the document.
